address.docs:
**int**: The address of the sensor. Required if there is more than one device on the bus and index is not specified.

*See also: [Dallas Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/dallas_temp#configuration-variables)*

index.docs:
**byte**: The index (0-based) of the sensor. Required if there is more than one device on the bus and address is not specified. *Note this index is based on the hardware addresses of the sensors and the order can change if sensors are changed, added, or removed.*

*See also: [Dallas Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/dallas_temp#configuration-variables)*

one_wire_id.docs:
**[One Wire](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/)**: The ID of the 1-Wire bus to use. Required if there is more than one bus.

*See also: [Dallas Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/dallas_temp#configuration-variables)*

resolution.docs:
**int**: An optional resolution from 9 to 12. Higher means more accurate. Defaults to the maximum for most Dallas temperature sensors: 12.

*See also: [Dallas Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/dallas_temp#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval that the sensors should be checked. Defaults to 60 seconds.

*See also: [Dallas Temperature Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/dallas_temp#configuration-variables)*
